segments.name: Environmental Services
products: industrial maintenance and specialty industrial services
segments.description: Provides hazardous and non-hazardous waste collection, treatment, recycling and disposal, plus emergency response and industrial services to customers across North America.
segments.evidence: We safely collect, transport, treat, recycle when suitable and dispose of hazardous and non-hazardous waste through our network of over 100 waste disposal facilities including incinerators; landfills; treatment, storage and disposal facilities, or TSDFs, wastewater treatment facilities; and solvent recycling centers.

segments.name: Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions
segments.description: Collects used oil and automotive fluids and re-refines them into base oil, lubricants and byproducts sold back to customers.
segments.evidence: SKSS provides collections services for used oil, used oil filters and other automotive related fluids, allowing customers to manage these wastes in a responsible and compliant way while also converting these waste streams into high quality products for re-use.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for waste collection, treatment, disposal and industrial services, and for re-refined base oil, lubricants and byproducts returned to the marketplace.
revenueModel.evidence: These gallons were then processed, along with additives and some purchased used oil, into new re-refined base oil, lubricants and byproducts, which were returned back into the marketplace.
